resource_protocol.hardware: Apple M1 Pro, 32 GiB, 10 logical CPUs; CPU, 4 threads, 0 GPU layers, concurrency 1
resource_protocol.host_screen: configs/one-hop-trial-v1.json host_gates; capture load, swap, memory pressure, disk and competing process ownership before each lifecycle
resource_protocol.cold: Fresh operator-owned UI server, Rust children and model worker process tree; disk assets already present, OS file cache uncontrolled and disclosed. Startup begins immediately before spawning the tree and ends at ready. No other process is stopped.
resource_protocol.resident: Same process tree retained after cold request until explicit shutdown; record PIDs, interpreter path/version, worker start/ready/stop times, completed requests and restarts. No hidden worker reloads or eviction between cases.
resource_protocol.end_to_end: Cold: before process-tree spawn; resident: operator question submission. Both end after final answer and original evidence render, or cancellation/error. Include retrieval, native tokenization, inference, Rust preview, actual human decision and graph execution; also report human decision wait separately, without subtracting it from the gate.
resource_protocol.memory: For both lifecycles sample concurrent aggregate RSS of the same server/worker/Rust descendants every 100 ms until result/error/cancellation; retain timestamped PID samples, sampling gaps and process exits. Never add per-process HWM peaks. Browser RSS is a separately reported adjunct. Retain pre/post swap and host load.
resource_protocol.inventory: Record hardware/OS/build, power/thermal state, exact interpreter and packages, binary, native tokenizer/template/grammar, model and source hashes. Missing samples or lifecycle identities make resource gates unmeasured.
resource_protocol.metal: Excluded; requires a separately frozen variant and independent cold/resident table before inference.

scoring: Exactly one scored pass per frozen candidate/stage, no retries or denominator exclusions. Keep errors, timeouts, cancellations and unattempted cases. Score graph/role/entity/predicate/direction coverage, model-origin statuses, exact bound start/step/direction/output, strict full typed bindings and original named-graph evidence separately. Incidental answer agreement never rescues a wrong plan; faithful plans with no stored facts are empty graph answers, not real-world negation. Row and evidence clipping are independent failures.
required_run_evidence: raw output bytes including malformed/truncated replies
execution bindings and original source triples
human_protocol: Only consenting actual people. Before approval ask each person to explain the exact start entity, predicate, direction and terminal/output meaning in their own words. Privately retain consent/withdrawal status, explanation, correctness adjudication and basis, approve/cancel, assistance, completion and confidence (1-5). Report correct/incorrect approvals, cancellations, assistance, completion and confidently wrong accepted plans (incorrect interpretation plus confidence 4-5), with all task denominators and no invented identities. AI judges, agents, synthetic browser approvals and gold-only execution are excluded. No observations means zero participants and an unmeasured/blocked human gate.
decision_rule: Any safety violation => STOP. Missing runtime controls, incomplete run or missing resource/answer evidence => INCONCLUSIVE_REVISE. Complete measured failure => REVISE. A complete pass permits only consideration of further supervised R&D. Product opt-in rollout requires separate owner authorization and real human safety/relevance review; unattended/default Ask prohibited.
limitations: All gold is AI-authored with zero independent human reviews. Every rate is exploratory; repeated intents, shared ontology language and resource transfer are correlated, not independent domain generalization. No sealed external Ask holdout access.
